metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Rises as CEO Jensen Huang Eases Debt Fears<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Stock Rises as CEO Eases AI Debt Fears
Nvidia stock was rising in premarket trading Wednesday as fears over the company’s exposure to debt fueling the artificial intelligence boom eased. CEO Jensen Huang looks like a market whisperer once again.
